rationale: The Court is likely to adopt a judgment-based, administrable rule: once the district court enters final judgment on the first federal habeas petition, any later filing advancing new substantive habeas claims is a "second or successive" application under Gonzalez and outside Banister’s narrow, judgment-integrated carveouts. Expect a principal dissent (likely by Justice Jackson) emphasizing that an appeal keeps the first proceeding ongoing and that remand/indicative-ruling tools can accommodate newly discovered claims without triggering AEDPA gatekeeping.
